methodology.startup: hyperfine --shell=none, 3 warmup runs then 20 measured runs (warm), or 20 measured runs each prepared with sync and echo 3 > /proc/sys/vm/drop_caches (cold). Mean, median and stddev are hyperfine's. One untimed --version primes each tool's empty HOME before the timed runs.
methodology.memory: /usr/bin/time -v on --version, 5 runs, median of Maximum resident set size (kbytes). Top-level process only.
methodology.sizes: download_bytes are files this run fetched (npm tarballs, the GitHub release asset, pip wheels). install_bytes is the byte size of the installed tree. package_bytes is the tool's own published artifacts (top-level package plus its platform package, or the aider wheel alone), not third-party dependencies. binary_bytes is the native ELF the command runs. A tool with only a script entrypoint is marked binary_kind=script and is left out of the native-binary ranking.
methodology.prompt: PTY 80x24. Timed only when a pinned transcript pattern appears. bwn is given a settings file so it does not stop in onboarding, with auto-update off.
methodology.task: Local mock OpenAI server (bench/mock_openai.py) returns BENCHMARK_OK for chat completions and the Responses API. Tools that cannot be pointed at that protocol are skipped. Each published time exited 0 and printed BENCHMARK_OK.
methodology.environment: Clean HOME per tool, no API keys except the dummy key used for the mock. PATH starts with that tool's install prefix.

notes: This row is the release binary invoked directly (the cargo-install / prebuilt entry), not the npm launcher.
download_bytes is the GitHub release asset. cargo install builds from source instead of downloading this file; the asset is what the npm launcher downloads on first run.
